semver: PATCH: one backward-compatible gameplay fix (party attack orders on units the player is shown but the party has not noticed). Saves/settings remain compatible; campaign protocol 23 and Autochess protocol 5 are unchanged.
release_scope: Expedited owner-requested patch on top of v1.36.0. The only game-code change is GameUnit.party_knows / UnitFog.shown_to and its regression test; engines, templates and graphics runtimes are reused unchanged from 1.36.0.

linux-x86_64.scope: Package built, exported and script-audited; the changed behaviour was tested headlessly from the release source, not in the packaged executable. Engine template unchanged from 1.36.0.

windows-x86_64.scope: Package built and script-audited only; engine and graphics runtimes unchanged from the 1.36.0 accepted package.

macos-universal.scope: Package built and script-audited only; engine unchanged from 1.36.0.

android.scope: APK built, signed with the public certificate and audited; no device run.

web.scope: Browser package built and audited; hosted browser build is updated separately.

limits: The full packaged regression suite was not rerun for this patch at the owner's request; 1.36.0 package acceptance covers the unchanged engines and runtimes.
No target-OS runtime runs were performed for 1.36.1.
Original-game comparison is from the decompiled attack-order logic; it was not reproduced under Wine for this patch.
Path tracing and frame generation remain experimental.
